title: distlock users file
description: Credentials for clients of the distlock server. A user's client_id is the application name that appears on every session it opens. Not expressible in this schema but enforced by the server at load time: client_id values must be unique (case-sensitive), and the file should not be readable by group or others.

$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the server.

description.description: Free-form note for humans; ignored by the server.

client_id.description: Application name and login name. Many processes may share one client_id; each opens its own session.

password_hash.description: bcrypt hash, cost 10-31 (12 recommended). Generate with scripts/hash-password.sh. Never store a plaintext password here.

enabled.description: false rejects new logins for this client_id without deleting the entry.

description.description: Free-form note for humans (owner, purpose); ignored by the server.
